Package neqsim.pvtsimulation.flowassurance

Class PitzerScaleActivityModel

java.lang.Object
neqsim.pvtsimulation.flowassurance.PitzerScaleActivityModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class PitzerScaleActivityModel extends Object implements Serializable
Binary Pitzer activity-coefficient model for NaCl-dominated oilfield brines.

The implementation follows Pitzer's virial formulation and evaluates the temperature-dependent binary parameters distributed with the USGS PHREEQC pitzer.dat database. It reproduces critically evaluated NaCl mean activity coefficients from dilute solution to halite saturation and maps trace-ion coefficients by the MacInnes convention at equivalent ionic strength. This makes it a materially better high-salinity screening model than Davies or B-dot.

This class is intentionally called a binary model. It does not include the complete multicomponent Pitzer theta and psi interaction matrix. For brines with large non-NaCl fractions, validate against a full Pitzer engine (for example PHREEQC) or a rigorously speciated NeqSim electrolyte equation of state.

References: Pitzer, J. Phys. Chem. 77 (1973) 268-277, DOI 10.1021/j100621a026; Hamer and Wu, J. Phys. Chem. Ref. Data 1 (1972) 1047-1100, DOI 10.1063/1.3253108; PHREEQC version 3 pitzer.dat.
